newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes says get short-term loan.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes says get short-term loan.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said it reached an agreement with Raytheon Aircraft Credit Corp to provide a short-term loan of $4 million.

As a part of the agreement, additional parties will be asked to participate in providing near-term working capital financing to assist the company in its return to normal operations, Great Lakes said.

Raytheon is being granted warrants for a term of 1O years, exercisable after 12 months, to purchase one million shares of Great Lakes stock, at a price of $0.75 per share, as a part of the transaction, Great Lakes said.

Great Lakes also said it reached an agreement with United Airlines Inc, a unit of UAL Corp, to extend a United Express agreement that had recently expired. The extension is in effect until August 31, Great Lakes said.
"The company is diligently working with United to complete a long term agreement," Great Lakes said.

A regional air carrier, Great Lakes voluntarily suspended all flights in May after the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration told the company it faced suspension of its operation authority due to flying "unairworthy aircraft."
Great Lakes has since reached an agreement with the FAA allowing the airline to resume flying.
